pathAssistantSteps.info:
A task order, modification or option exercise under an existing contract.

Set Type, and link the Contract it grows.

Contract floors: Cost Plus 7%, T&M 10%, Fixed Price 12%. The Margin Guardrail shows the gap.

Below the floor? Submit for Pricing Review now: the opportunity can't move to Proposal Submitted until it's approved. Regenerate the Pricing Rationale with Einstein for the approver.
Set Close Date to when the contracting officer expects to act. For an option, that's the option exercise date.
Confirm funding with the contracting office before the decision date.
The work is added to the existing contract: update its value and funding. Leave Create Contract on Win unticked unless it's a separate contract.

Loss Reason is required. Set Lost To for the winning competitor: it feeds Competitor Intel and the Margin & Competition dashboard.

Request a debrief within three days of the award notice.
Record why we passed. No Bid deals stay out of win rates.
